formula: Contribution Score = 0.50 * Adjusted_P2 + 0.50 * Adjusted_P3, where Adjusted = clip(50 + (Raw - 50) * L(P1), 0.1, 99.9) and L(P1) = clip(1.0 + 0.35 * ((P1 - 50) / 50), 0.65, 1.35)
